lines.en: I walk very close to you.
My face is right by your shoulder.
Every step crowds into you.
No need to chase; you are right here.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸是假的，声音很近
lines.en: My breath is fake, but very near.
I flatten every blade I step on.
I come near but never touch.
My steps are at your ear.
I travel along the edge of your view.
Distance is too heavy for me.
Turn around; I am already near.
I move like a texture pasted on.
I am right here, not moving.
Up close, my blocks look duller.
You can see the seams on my face.
I do not blink; you can check.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有一格空隙
lines.en: There is not a single block between us.
I stand here and your breathing changes.
Too close, I know.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓压着你的影子
lines.en: My outline presses on your shadow.

lines.zh: 我看得见你毛孔的细节
lines.en: I can see the details of your skin.
I simply occupy this one square.
Do not back away; it stays this close.
My stillness is heavier than motion.
I am inside your focus.
Do you hear the air being pushed aside?
Our faces are a hair apart.

lines.zh: 我看见你瞳孔里的小方块
lines.en: I see a small cube in your pupil.
This close, you cannot escape my gaze.
I face you without the slightest tilt.
I look bigger in your eyes than I am.
Do you think I should step back?
My face carries no warmth.
You have been looking at me a while.
I have memorized your expression.
My eyes turn with yours.
It is too narrow here to look anywhere else.
Your breath lands on my face.

lines.zh: 近看，我的嘴是画上去的
lines.en: Up close, my mouth is only painted on.
You are searching for a flaw in me.

lines.zh: 我看你，你看我，没人先动
lines.en: We look; neither moves first.

lines.zh: 我这张脸让你记住了吗
lines.en: Has this face stuck in your mind?
Three inches away; close enough.

lines.zh: 我一毫米一毫米地靠近
lines.en: I close in millimeter by millimeter.
Do not turn away; I am not done looking.
Your elbow sank into my chest.
I reeled, but did not step back.

lines.zh: 这具方块身体裂了条缝
lines.en: A crack opened in this blocky body.
The blow made me thinner.
You hit from close; I saw it well.

lines.zh: 我不叫疼，我叫你的名字
lines.en: I do not cry out in pain; I say your name.
The broken part is perfectly flat.
I gave up half a block.
Your knuckles hurt too, no?
Hit again; I want to see the crack.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，就在我脸前
lines.en: You hold the food right by my face.
This close, I smell your hand.
I will not eat; I want to watch it rot.
You are most unguarded when feeding me.
The food is blocking your eyes.
I open my mouth only to imitate.

lines.zh: 你不由得把手伸得更近
lines.en: You cannot help reaching closer.
The smell presses against my face.
Set it down and I will come to it.
What I want is not that piece of meat.
We collided whole.
Too close not to touch.
Your shoulder met my edge.
My body has no give.
That was a solid hit.
We overlapped by half a block.
Push me; I do not budge.
The sound got trapped between us.
No room to yield.
Your armor scraped loud.
I come close, but not to court.

lines.zh: 这里只有你和我两具形体
lines.en: Only two shapes here: you and me.
I want to see if we can overlap.
Duplication needs no partner.
You step back; I fill the step.
My kin is myself.

lines.zh: 亲密在这种距离下很危险
lines.en: Closeness is dangerous at this range.
I did not come for a mate.
Two do not fit in this square.
Standing pressed together all night is fine.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西落在我脚边
lines.en: What you dropped landed at my feet.

lines.zh: 我伸手，几乎碰到你的手指
lines.en: I reach and nearly touch your fingers.
I pick it up, and only then do you look down.
It shrinks in my palm.

lines.zh: 这么近，你看得见我拿走
lines.en: This close, you see me take it.
I do not hide it; I hold it up.

lines.zh: 你的东西现在贴着我的胸口
lines.en: Your thing rests against my chest.
As I bend, my face comes near.
You reach; I retreat half a block.

lines.zh: 捡东西是我靠近的借口
lines.en: Picking things up is my excuse to come near.
At this range, locking on is easy.

lines.zh: 你就在我面前，别装没看见
lines.en: You are right in front of me.
No search needed; you never moved.
This square is mine now.
The target is touching me; how nice.
I lift my face and aim it at you.
Step back and I follow, close.
This near, I need no footsteps.

lines.zh: 我看见你喉结动了一下
lines.en: I saw your throat move.
I will chase you from this inch.
Your back is right before me.
Do you hear me at your neck?
Lock range: zero.

lines.zh: 你已经在我怀里那么近了
lines.en: You are nearly in my arms.
Running only keeps you in my sight.
Do not turn; you will hit my face.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走过每一道门
lines.en: I follow you through every door, close.
Speed up; I do not need to.

lines.zh: 我的手快碰到你的衣角
lines.en: My hand almost catches your hem.

lines.zh: 你在前面，我在你影子里
lines.en: You are ahead; I am in your shadow.

lines.zh: 拐角太窄，我们得一起过
lines.en: The corner is narrow; we pass together.
I stay half a block away, always.
Your breathing is getting shallow.
I can hear you clench your teeth.
The door caught my edge as you shut it.
I shuffle along behind you.
The more afraid you are, the tighter I stay.
Your torch heats my face.
We cross the hall in step.
Your steps have gone out of rhythm.
I need not chase; you always stop.
You wait for the lift; so do I.
Close enough to hear my joints.
Turn, and I press in again.
My silhouette sticks to yours.

lines.zh: 你哪儿也去不了，我保证
lines.en: You are going nowhere; I promise.
This close, my hand arrives at once.
No lunge needed to hit you.

lines.zh: 我的指节撞在你肋骨上
lines.en: My knuckle knocks your ribs.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有距离可躲
lines.en: No distance left to dodge.
This swat lands dull and solid.
You were already retreating as I raised my hand.

lines.zh: 近距离没有闪避的余地
lines.en: At this range there is no room to dodge.
My hand grazes past your cheek.
You retreat half a step; still too close.
I strike with skin that has no warmth.
I hear bone creak.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，只是很近
lines.en: Not heavy, just very near.
Your armor's rim saved you.
I push off right against your chest.
The pain will arrive half a beat late.
I need no wind-up for a second blow.

lines.zh: 我出现时脸已经对着你
lines.en: I appeared with my face already toward you.
Too close, my apologies.

lines.zh: 你加载进来的地方正好是我
lines.en: You loaded in exactly where I was.

lines.zh: 我从你眼前的一格里长出来
lines.en: I grew out of the square before your eyes.

lines.zh: 这次没有声音，只有距离
lines.en: No sound this time, only distance.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时我靠近了一格
lines.en: I closed one block while you blinked.
The room is the same, plus me.

lines.zh: 我从你的视野中间浮现
lines.en: I surfaced in the middle of your view.

lines.zh: 你第一眼就看见我的脸
lines.en: The first thing you saw was my face.

lines.zh: 我站的地方原本是你的站位
lines.en: I stand where you were standing.

lines.zh: 空气挤了一下，我就到了
lines.en: The air squeezed, and I was here.
Do not step back; the wall is behind you.

lines.zh: 我从存档的缝里爬出来
lines.en: I crawled out of a seam in the save.

lines.zh: 这具形体一出现就贴着人
lines.en: This shape arrives already touching someone.
What you hear is not the wind.
Forming took me half a second.

lines.zh: 你就站在我呼吸的范围里
lines.en: You stand within my fake breath.
There is one more shadow at the door.
Up close, I almost look real.

lines.zh: 我到了，游戏还在加载吗
lines.en: I am here; is the game still loading?

lines.zh: 我的面皮被烤得卷起来
lines.en: The fire curled my painted face.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我的棱角碎了
lines.en: I fell and my corners shattered.

lines.zh: 水从我嘴的缝里灌进去
lines.en: Water seeps in through the seam of my mouth.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我整张贴图掀开
lines.en: The blast peeled my whole texture off.

lines.zh: 箭身插进我脸旁的方块
lines.en: The arrow lodges beside my face.

lines.zh: 咒语让我的轮廓闪了一下
lines.en: The spell made my outline flicker.
I do not eat; hunger bleaches me.

lines.zh: 雷光把我照成一格平面
lines.en: Lightning flattens me into one square.
The void erases me at close range.
